title: External production release evidence collection
rules: A source verifier passing is not external production evidence.
A criterion may be marked VERIFIED only when evidence_file points to a non-empty file under this directory and evidence_summary describes what was observed.
Do not store passwords, API keys, service-role keys, access tokens, payment credentials, customer data, or personal data in this evidence pack.
Redact account identifiers and customer information from screenshots and logs.
Keep production migration application, payment activation and DNS cutover approval-controlled.

criteria.requirement: A successful CI run exists for the exact release commit.
npm ci, lint, typecheck, production build and responsive browser suite pass on the release candidate.
Linked migration list is reviewed and remote history is reconciled with 169 source migrations.
Linked db push dry-run and db lint are reviewed; no unexpected destructive or out-of-scope operation remains.
Production Auth Site URL, redirect allow-list, email verification and recovery flows pass real UAT.
Exact release commit is deployed; deployment logs, production environment parity and domain attachment are verified.
Apex HTTPS, www canonical redirect, SPA deep links, security headers and production smoke tests pass.
Selected provider sandbox UAT proves success, failure, duplicate callback, invalid signature, reversal and full/partial refund; provider remains disabled if no approved adapter exists.
Sender-domain authentication and real email/SMS delivery callbacks are verified without exposing secrets.
Catalogue, checkout, delivery, projects, invoices, customer portal and after-sales workflows are signed off by business owners.
Approved web DNS records are documented and mail MX/SPF/DKIM/DMARC records are confirmed unchanged.
Rollback to the previous website target is tested or rehearsed; existing cPanel mail and old website remain available until sign-off.
Named technical and business owners approve production cutover and record the release commit and deployment URL.
